title: AI Hedge Fund — Deep Value instance configuration
description: Reaches the manager as ManagerInvocation.config. Every field here corresponds to something the source harness put in its own YAML: the analyst blend weights are `StrategySpec.models[].weight` and the conviction floor is the `min-conviction floor` its portfolio-construction module names as the obvious next knob. What is deliberately NOT here is anything the Kernel owns — position caps and gross exposure were `RiskLimits` upstream and are the investor's Mandate here, so putting them in a manager's config would let a package argue with the constraint it is judged against. Aumos resolves this file and deliberately does not validate instance config against it — a half-validator would report a pass it did not establish.

analystWeights.description: How much each analyst's conviction counts in the blend. The defaults are the source's own `hedge_fund/strategies/deep-value.yaml`, in which Graham leads at double weight and Buffett and Munger keep quality in the mix.

convictionFloor.description: The smallest blended conviction that may move the book. Below it the judgement is WAIT or WATCH rather than a target. Upstream this floor did not exist and its absence is documented as a known wart — a lone weak view received the full gross target and the risk stage then clamped it. Aumos cannot inherit that shape: a breaching target is not clamped here, it is downgraded to WAIT and the whole judgement is lost, so the floor moves from a nice-to-have to a requirement.

requireMajority.description: Whether a target needs at least two of the three analysts on the same side. The source blended arithmetically with no such rule; this exists because Aumos records one judgement per run rather than a continuously rebalanced sleeve, so a single dissenting-but-loud analyst is not diluted by tomorrow's tick.
